# Idea Brief: Faceless AI history Shorts channel

- **Id:** 20261101-faceless-shorts-history
- **Category:** 1 Content platforms
- **Method playbook:** research/playbooks/faceless-shorts-channel.md
- **Date:** 2026-11-01

## What it is
Three AI-narrated history-fact Shorts a day from stock footage, monetised via
the YouTube Partner Program once 1,000 subscribers and 10M Shorts views are
reached.

## Who pays, how much, how often
YouTube ad revenue share; no direct customers.

## Evidence (minimum two independent sources, at least one platform-level or first-person with numbers)
| Source | URL | Date seen | Type | What it shows (numbers) |
|--------|-----|-----------|------|-------------------------|
| Faceless channel income guide | https://www.clipspeed.ai/blog/faceless-youtube-channel-income-report-2026.html | 2026-10-25 | tool vendor | claims USD 200-1,500/month in months 5-8 |
| vidIQ Shorts RPM | https://vidiq.com/blog/post/youtube-shorts-monetization/ | 2026-10-25 | tool vendor | RPM USD 0.03-0.06 per 1,000 views |

## Why it works now
Short-form demand keeps growing.

## What would kill it
- YouTube inauthentic-content policy (15 Jul 2025) covers templated AI narration
- YPP thresholds double on 1 Feb 2027

## Platform and payout check (from research/platform-rules.md and management/payments.md)
- Platform usable by a Qatar-resident seller: yes (YPP lists Qatar); payout by wire
- Payout route: AdSense wire
- Published volume caps and disclosure duties that apply: inauthentic-content policy; AI-use disclosure
